newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end off in light holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end off in light holiday trade.

text.p: Chilean stocks ended weak in light Christmas trade with the bolsa seen remaining in negative territory at Thursday's opening on uncertainty in the heavyweight power sector, said traders.
"I expect the market to be undermined by more adjustments in electricity stocks," said one dealer.
The 40-share IPSA index ended unofficially down 0.25 percent at 87.67 points. The general IGPA index shed 0.11 percent to 4,868.13 points.
The stock market closed at 1400 local (1700 GMT) and will reopen Thursday at 0930 local (1230 GMT).
Volume shrank to just 3.7 billion pesos, comapred with usual levels of around 12 billion pesos.
Traders said Tuesday's turnover included 1.2 billion pesos came from dealing in department store Almacenes Paris stock.
Decliners included power utility Enersis, down 1.14 percent at 216 pesos, bottler Andina, down 0.97 percent at 2,030 pesos and glass-maker Cristales which lost 0.79 percent to 2,500 pesos.
